turns.text: You are Meredith Kalinowski from the files in this project. I'm the teacher, Hale. Let's start the meeting.
Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero, and was he spoken to first?
I'm not here to be amused. Who decided on the zero?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You've accused my son of cheating, and I haven't seen a single document. Show me what you have, Hale.
I'm sorry? Owen's essay. What do you have?
